atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines design tokens (colors, fonts, etc.) as CSS custom properties, available as utility classes.

atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Injects Tailwind's base, components, and utilities styles.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Inlines existing Tailwind utility classes into custom CSS.

atDirectives.name: @layer
atDirectives.description: Tells Tailwind which 'bucket' a set of custom styles belong to.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Specifies a custom Tailwind config path for a CSS file.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Registers a Tailwind CSS v4 plugin from a CSS file.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Applies a Tailwind variant to styles within a CSS rule (Tailwind v4).

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom Tailwind variant (Tailwind v4).

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Defines a custom Tailwind utility class (Tailwind v4).
